name: Natassja Romanov
source:
Former Miss Ukraine.

She was offered a contract to work in L.A. as a model. She accepted in order to help her once wealthy family who lost everything due to her country's goverment corruption, which hired her father's company to develop multifamily buildings and never payed the other half. He faced numerous lawsuits from his employees and creditors and eventually ended up in a white collar jail. They lost their wealth and social status.

Since then, she's been afraid of spoiling her son, due to what she had to suffer.

[In game description]
